phase: Phase 4 — Probability quality (evaluation protocol FROZEN sebelum evaluasi)
principle: probability quality audit + optional minimal recalibration; BUKAN model improvement. Evaluasi production probability path, per target x horizon, PIT-integrity.

previous_close.definition: event = close[i] <= close[i-1]*(1-drop/100); outcome = max(high[i+1..i+h]) >= close[i-1]; censored bila window tidak penuh
previous_close.drop_source: RECOVERY_DROP_DEFAULT (setup standar; auto-drop per-saham tidak dipakai di audit agar konsisten & PIT-safe)

prior_peak.definition: observasi = setiap hari dalam drawdown (dd>0); peak = max(close) trailing 252 hari; outcome = max(high[i+1..i+h]) >= peak[i]; censored bila window tidak penuh

previous_close.note: p=(k+a0)/(n+a0+b0); prior per (bucket drop 2-20%, horizon); legacy hard switch n>=5 TIDAK dievaluasi sebagai production path

prior_peak.note: P=1/(1+exp(a_h+b_h*dd)); point probability dievaluasi (CI delta-method produksi tidak dipakai sebagai kriteria P4)

3_probability_source_version.config_version: config.py RECOVERY block: RECOVERY_DROP_DEFAULT=5.0, RECOVERY_SIGNAL_P_MIN=0.68, RECOVERY_MODEL_P_MIN=0.5, RECOVERY_PEAK_LOOKBACK_DAYS=252, RECOVERY_MODEL_DD_CLAMP=0.85, RECOVERY_HORIZONS_DAYS=[1,3,5,10,21,42,63]

4_episode_representation.unit_observation_previous_close: event gap-down (satu baris per event i)
4_episode_representation.episode_id: (code, run_id) dengan run = run kontigu hari in-drawdown/in-setup
4_episode_representation.note: n_episodes = jumlah run unik; n_events = jumlah observasi

5_split.dev: date_s <= cutoff DAN future window (t+h) <= cutoff (purged)
5_split.note: validation window SUDAH dibuka oleh Phase 3 -> hanya temporal validation, BUKAN final locked holdout (P4.8)

6_regime_definition.rules: ADX14 < 20 -> sideways; selain itu close > SMA200 -> bull, else bear
6_regime_definition.note: regime TIDAK di-tuning dari hasil P4

7_base_rate_reference.method: climatology per (target, horizon): event rate pada DEV (data <= cutoff, purged), dihitung SEBELUM melihat validation
7_base_rate_reference.prohibited: validation/test prevalence TIDAK boleh dipakai sebagai reference

primary.method: stock-cluster resample (sample stock with replacement, retain semua observasi stock terpilih)

9_calibration_method_candidates.calibration_window: subset temporal akhir DEV (126 hari trading terakhir sebelum cutoff, purged)

PASS_all_of: BSS > 0 (ideally CI > 0) terhadap reference yang di-freeze
flexible curve tanpa deviation material di region produksi (p ~ 0.68 utk previous_close, p ~ 0.5 utk prior_peak)
tidak ada calibration collapse di regime utama dgn sample cukup
FAIL_any_of: holdout hanya bisa diperoleh setelah tuning ulang
10_acceptance_criteria.INCONCLUSIVE: CI lebar -> INSUFFICIENT PRECISION (bukan calibrated, bukan miscalibrated)
10_acceptance_criteria.no_hl_test: Hosmer-Lemeshow TIDAK dipakai sebagai primary test (grouping-dependent)

11_sharpness: diagnostic only: distribusi p (p10/p25/median/p75/p90 + histogram) — sharpness subject to calibration
12_prohibited: memakai Phase 3 OOS sebagai final locked holdout
